The '''H2-1 hyperdrive''' was a [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] unit manufactured by the [[Corellian Engineering Corporation/Legends|Corellian Engineering Corporation]]. A modified H2-1 was installed in the ''[[Stinger]]'' by the [[Human replica droid]] [[Guri]] on behalf of [[Prince/Legends|Prince]] [[Xizor/Legends|Xizor]].<ref name="EGVV" />
